Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `eae9d624e1f09e7407f73d0cad51705faff9c83b`
Local-runs: none
Scope: every diff path — `.changeset/29704-plain-publish-sheet-and-load-errors.md`; `ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/DraftChangesPanel.tsx`, `preview/changeKeyLabels.ts`, `preview/__tests__/DraftChangesPanel.{bundleMember-12271,fieldRows-13125,generatedGroup-25890,groupHeading-13221,namedChanges-27835,protectionEnvelope-12594}.test.tsx`; `app-shell/src/views/PageView.tsx`, `views/RecordDetailView.tsx`, `views/RecordDetailView.recordReadFailure-11902.test.tsx`, `views/__tests__/PageView.appPageRecord-12931.test.tsx`; `views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, `metadata-admin/metadata-form-i18n.ts`, new `metadata-admin/schema-field-label.ts`; `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/{ar,de,en,es,fr,ja,ko,pt,ru,zh}.ts`; `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`; `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`, `plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.loadErrorKind.test.tsx`; `ui/packages/react/src/index.ts`, `react/src/utils/error-message.ts`, `react/src/utils/error-message.test.ts` — read against `main`: `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` L61–67 and L791–815 (the moved members and the studio-namespace import), `metadata-admin/metadata-form-i18n.ts` L84–87 (imports), `react/src/utils/error-message.ts` L40 (`firstString`), `packages/spec/src/kernel/override-declaration.zod.ts` L134 and `kernel/index.ts` L45, the `email_template` count family in all ten packs, card #29704 with the claim, the PM re-measure, the amendment, and os-dev report 6595413392.

Read-only; nothing built or run. Card #29704 (publish sheet in plain words; load errors carry the server's reason).

### ① Derived judgments

- **The widening is exactly what the changeset and the amended claim name.** `@object-ui/react` gains `answeredLoadFailure` and the type `AnsweredLoadFailure` from the barrel (two lines in `index.ts`; nothing leaves the export list). The ten packs gain `preview.changes.detailNewItem` and the `preview.changes.typeCount.object_extension` count family; each pack's family has the same plural forms as its existing `email_template` family (ar six, ru four, es/fr/pt three with `_many`, the rest two), so `count-families-11445` and key parity hold by shape. No key is removed.
- **The schema-field-label move is functionally verbatim.** `isZhLocale`, `SCHEMA_FIELD_LABEL_ZH`, `SCHEMA_FIELD_HELP_ZH`, `translateSchemaFieldLabel` and `translateSchemaFieldHelp` carry the same bodies; the only textual difference is the parameter type `SupportedLocale | string` → `string`, which is the same type (`SupportedLocale` is a string-literal union). `i18n.ts` re-exports all three names, so every existing importer resolves unchanged.
- **The eager graph stays off the studio namespace.** `changeKeyLabels.ts` now imports `localizeMetadataForm` (whose runtime imports are `@objectstack/spec/system` and `field-source-label.js`; its `i18n.js` import is type-only after this diff) and the new import-free leaf. On `main` `metadata-form-i18n.ts` imported `isZhLocale` from `i18n.ts` at runtime, which carries `@object-ui/i18n/namespaces/studio`; the diff is what makes the overlay safe to read from the sheet, and the dev's `check-sdui-manifest` / gate sweep is consistent with that.
- **The declaration drop reads the spec, not a literal.** `OVERRIDE_DECLARATION_KEYS = Object.keys(OverrideDeclarationFields)` from `@objectstack/spec/kernel` (exported via `kernel/index.ts` L45), beside the existing `MetadataProtectionFields` pattern; the key list is `['overrides']` today and follows the spec if it grows.
- **The one rule is one function.** `answeredLoadFailure` lifts RelatedList's `serverSentence` test (numeric `httpStatus`/`status`/`statusCode`) and adds the `HTTP \d{3}` message test that `classifyLoadError` already uses; the sentence goes through `extractWriteErrorMessage` and the wrapped `{ error: { code, message } }` under `details`. It returns text, not a kind, and every caller gates by kind: ListView only on `network`, RelatedList only when `LOAD_FAILED_COPY[kind].message` is null (so never on a refusal), RecordDetailView and PageView only in `failed` (`forbidden` is split off first; a 404 still resolves `null` → missing).
- **The machine-name chip still follows the spec's label.** `KeyRow` labels through `formKeyLabel(type, name, locale)` and judges the chip on `formKeyLabel(type, name)` (English), per objectui#8231.

### ② Semver level

- All five packages patch, `Clause-②: yes (widening)` (one new react export, two new pack keys), `Metadata-protocol: none` → patch is the level the protocol axis gives. No ADR-0087 marker is needed: nothing retires; the moved members keep their names at their old import path.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Not Tier H. CI on `eae9d624` was in progress when this was written (14 success, 11 skipped, 27 in progress, 0 failure).
- `Fixes #29704` closes the card. The route-level `RouteObjectReadFailed` case the card named at `AppContent.tsx:2112` is out by the amended claim and filed as #29728; the card's second part is therefore closed on the measured sites (ListView, RecordDetailView, PageView, RelatedList), not on the console route.
- Report deviation 4 is worth a card line, not a hold: on the plain count read (`top=0`) the adapter memoises an answered 404 as an empty collection, so #29673's records page still reads 「这里还没有数据」 on that path and the server's sentence appears only on the expand read. The seat should file it so the card's business reason ("when a page cannot load, it should say why") is not left half-true on the exact symptom the card measured.
- `DraftChangesPanel.tsx` and the packs are also edited by seat 1's #29691 (PR #29723) on different members/keys; main was merged twice here, and the queue's `check-sdui-manifest` digest line is the usual conflict point — re-merge before enqueueing if #29723 lands first.
- The six moved pins are pin edits only (new-item key list and 平台生成 group assertions moved onto updates); the surface addition of `fieldRows-13125` and `bundleMember-12271` is recorded as approved by the seat in the report.

### ④ Design judgment

- A new item is "added whole": listing its creation keys told the person nothing they changed, and the platform-provisioned columns even less. Keeping `Includes:` for fields and flow nodes it brings, and one sentence otherwise, is the right cut. Dropping the override declaration alongside the protection envelope is correct: on a customized item it is a product of the publish, not of the person's edit, and any key the person actually overrode still shows as its own row.
- The load-error rule puts the burden where it belongs: the network sentence is now true only when it is true. Quoting the server's sentence verbatim means an English server sentence in a zh console; that is the card's direction (the server's "real reason") and better than a wrong localized one. The `forbidden` kinds keeping fixed copy is the right narrowing of what a refusal may say.
- Narrowing face: nothing a consumer could rely on is taken away. The sheet's `+ overrides` row and a new item's key rows were engine detail shown by accident, not a declared capability.

No must-fix. No should-fix.
